name: beyond-erp
description: Beyond ERP - Enterprise Resource Planning System

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --restart-tries 5 --restart-after 1000 -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
